retryLedger.cause: the first runtime-asset extraction left the copied helper block in its original module
retryLedger.resolution: removed the duplicate helpers in bounded patches and kept runtime admission in one leaf module

retryLedger.cause: the new asset module initially imported a provider-only binding from the narrower public Sandbox barrel
retryLedger.resolution: imported the internal SPI type from its leaf module while preserving the public Sandbox surface

retryLedger.cause: one legacy test still expected OCI LSP to reject every container instead of requiring image-bound assets
retryLedger.resolution: updated the assertion to the new fail-closed missing-image-identity contract

retryLedger.cause: persistent LSP Session launch branching exceeded the per-file line budget by seven lines
retryLedger.resolution: kept provider admission in the asset resolver and compacted the Session module back to its 500-line boundary

retryLedger.cause: the first SDK closure recapture preceded the final Runtime build, so the later full build legitimately changed dist hashes
retryLedger.resolution: fixed the order to final source, full Runtime build, evidence recapture, then immutable verification

retryLedger.cause: an existing deterministic Coding Benchmark exceeded its 15 second test-local timeout during the first parallel root suite
retryLedger.resolution: reran the exact failed test independently before repeating the complete gate
